wakingUp.title: Waking up the engine…
wakingUp.body: The free server sleeps when idle. The first request can take up to a minute; everything after is fast.

common.metaDescription: Public-sector data engine: ingest, clean, model, predict and report — in English and Spanish.

landing.eyebrow: Public-sector data engine · EN / FR / ES data
landing.title: From messy public files to decisions you can defend.
landing.subtitle: Upload contracts, budgets or program data. CivicLens profiles it, teaches you how to clean it, models it in SQL, flags what deserves a second look, and builds the executive report.
landing.status: Early build — the full experience is under construction.

design.title: Components and tokens
design.intro: Every screen is built from these pieces. Switch the language in the header: all text, numbers and dates change with it.

type.body: Body · 16 / 400 — We read the file as-is. Nothing is changed yet.
type.small: Small · 13 / 400 — CSV, XLSX or JSON · up to 50 MB · deleted after 24 h

buttons.stateNote: Every button has hover, keyboard focus (blue ring) and disabled states.

pii.title: Personal data detected
pii.body: 2 columns look like personal information. Mask them before analysis so they never reach a chart, export or API response.

design.warning: Flags are leads for human review, never accusations. Results depend on data quality and on thresholds set per jurisdiction.

issue.title: Amounts are in 3 different currencies
issue.found: {cop} rows in COP, {usd} in USD and {cad} in CAD inside amount_original.
issue.why: adding them together makes total spend meaningless, and comparing Colombia with Canada needs a single currency.

options.CADHint: Best for comparing with the Canadian datasets
options.COPHint: Keeps the Colombian report in local currency
options.KEEPHint: Nothing is overwritten; one extra column

issue.impactNote: FX table: rate on each contract's signed date · source cited in the dataset card
issue.learnMore: Learn more: why currency normalization comes before KPIs
issue.replayNote: Saved recipes can be replayed on next month's file — from here or through the API.
